name: image-upload-grid
title: Image upload grid
description: Manage the images of a product or a gallery: add tiles, mark the first as main, reorder with buttons or drag, and remove.
docs: images is the set to show, { id, src, alt }[], the first one the main image. The grid arranges and never uploads: files from the add tile, or dropped on the grid, pass the accept, maxSize and room checks and onFilesAdded receives those that passed; make an image of each (an object URL gives an instant preview), start the upload and put it in images. onImagesChange receives the new set after a move or a removal, by the buttons or by dragging a tile onto another. Each tile has Move earlier, Move later and Remove buttons, shown on hover and focus, always on a screen that cannot hover, and always reachable by keyboard. max shows the count as 5 of 8 and, once reached, switches the add tile off and says why. Moves, removals and additions are spoken, and focus stays on the button that was pressed. labels carries every word.
